description: This file defines a singleton class 'TalkAudioPlayer' that manages audio playback for text-to-speech within an application. It wraps AVAudioPlayer and includes mechanisms for asynchronous playback control, timeout watchdogs, and resilience to playback failures.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayer
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for audio playback management, including starting, stopping, and watchdog monitoring for the playback.

classes.name: Playback
classes.description: A nested class within 'TalkAudioPlayer' that manages continuation, watchdog task, and playback completion status, ensuring thread-safe state updates and communication.

methods.name: play(data: Data) async -> TalkPlaybackResult
methods.description: Asynchronously initiates playback of audio data, handling errors and setting up watchdog timers.

methods.name: stop() -> Double?
methods.description: Stops current playback if any, returning the current playback time.

methods.name: audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool)
methods.description: Delegate method called when audio playback finishes successfully, marking the playback as finished.

methods.name: stopInternal(finished: Bool, interruptedAt: Double?)
methods.description: Internal method to stop playback and update the playback result.

methods.name: finish(playback: Playback, result: TalkPlaybackResult)
methods.description: Completes playback, cancels watchdogs, and resumes any awaiting continuations.

methods.name: armWatchdog(playback: Playback)
methods.description: Sets up a watchdog task to monitor playback health and timeout conditions.
